'''Reid Smith''' (also published as '''R. Smith'''; DeckTech handle '''Voice of Law''') is a Star Wars CCG tournament player. He was runner-up to Brandon Schele at the [[2004 World Championship]].<ref name="awards">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ Awards], Players Committee, starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230817222457/https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ Internet Archive]</ref> The 2009 Match Play Championship pre-registration list gave his state as Pennsylvania (PA) and his username as ''3MW0J8''.<ref name="t22347">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=22347 MPC 2009 pre-registration list], Star Wars CCG Players Committee forum (9 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012213614/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22347.html Internet Archive]</ref> His 2010 and 2011 Worlds Day 2 sheets are printed ''R Smith'' with the same username.<ref name="w2010d2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2010/2010+Worlds+D2.pdf 2010 Worlds Day 2 decklists (PDF)], res.starwarsccg.org, pages 103–104. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008202452/http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2010/2010+Worlds+D2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="w2011d2">[http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2011/Worlds/2011+World_d2.pdf 2011 Worlds Day 2 decklists (PDF)], res.starwarsccg.org, pages 13–14. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008202422/http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2011/Worlds/2011+World_d2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

In 1999–2001 he played in Rochester, New York, and posted decklists and tournament reports on DeckTech as R. "Voice of Law" Smith.<ref name="dt-12242">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12242 Age of Aquaris], DeckTech (R. "Voice of Law" Smith, 11 December 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/12242/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/12242/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018084920/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12242/ Wayback Machine].</ref><ref name="tr-d1337">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-13-coruscant-operative-reportingd1337/ coruscant-operative-reporting], DeckTech (Chris "Jank" Jank, 13 October 2000): "Reid Smith (Voice of Law on Decktech)". Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-13-coruscant-operative-reportingd1337/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
